summary: No public author gene-level result was located for diabetic versus control whole hypothalamus. GEO supplies raw counts for 12 libraries, and the registered analysis uses four diabetic and three control libraries. The related publications report a different RNA-seq cohort or an arcuate protein measurement.

manualReview.summary: The deposited count matrix matches the registered input checksum. Author differential-expression results were not located.
manualReview.note: All 78,334 deposited feature rows contain only Ensembl IDs and counts for the 12 labeled libraries. The compressed GEO matrix matches the producer's input SHA-256 (0c4aace9f4a58a80d6493df1d5c0750e7901087107a603ab98f6a91194d72931). The registered diabetic_vs_control contrast uses DM1–DM4 relative to C1–C3. The GEO sample records, ENA, publication and preprint indexes, supplements and repository searches are documented in the dated evidence folder.
reviewFlags: Public records do not establish mouse identity, pooling or litter allocation for the registered libraries.
The curcumin paper reports arcuate Lep-Rb protein. Its listed supplementary PDF was inaccessible, and its relationship to the sequenced libraries is undocumented.

verificationReview.reason: No full or selected-gene author RNA result was located for DM1–DM4 versus C1–C3. GEO supplies counts, ENA lists read runs, the related RNA-seq article studies diet-induced obesity, and the curcumin study measures arcuate Lep-Rb protein. Author effect concordance, P values and FDR remain unassessed.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen if the authors identify a public gene-level diabetic-versus-control RNA result for these libraries. Confirm its sample membership, effect definition and contrast direction before comparison.
